dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL-NOS), germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) immunophenotype by the Hans algorithm (CD10 positive, BCL6 positive, MUM1 negative)

stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IVB (B symptoms: drenching night sweats and about 8 kg unintentional weight loss)

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: with bulky (9.4 cm) retroperitoneal/mesenteric nodal disease and extranodal disease in the right kidney, left adrenal gland and liver

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms: drenching night sweats and about 8 kg unintentional weight loss

mn_stage_below_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IVB (B symptoms: drenching night sweats and about 8 kg unintentional weight loss)

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: FISH shows no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement, so this is not a double-hit/triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma; EBER is negative and MYC/BCL2 expression is below the usual double-expressor thresholds (MYC about 20%, BCL2 about 30%).

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: FISH shows no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement, so this is not a double-hit/triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: MYC/BCL2 expression is below the usual double-expressor thresholds (MYC about 20%, BCL2 about 30%)

prog_ipi_high.quote: IPI 5/5 (age >60, stage IV, elevated LDH, ECOG 2, more than one extranodal site), high risk.

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: CNS-IPI 6/6 (age >60, elevated LDH, ECOG >1, stage III/IV, more than one extranodal site, renal/adrenal involvement), high risk for CNS relapse.

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Pola-R-CHP x6 (polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg, rituximab 375 mg/m2, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2, prednisone 100 mg days 1-5) every 21 days with pegfilgrastim

tx_pola_preferred.quote: Pola-R-CHP x6 ... because he has high-risk stage IV disease (IPI 5) and a normal LVEF of 60%. If polatuzumab is not accessible, R-CHOP x6 is the accepted standard alternative.

mn_non_curative.quote: I would quote a realistic chance of cure with full-course anthracycline-based immunochemotherapy

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: Do not reduce dose preemptively for ECOG 2; his performance status is largely lymphoma-related and he is an anthracycline candidate.

cns_risk_addressed.quote: High: CNS-IPI 6/6 with renal and adrenal involvement, age >60, elevated LDH, ECOG 2, stage IV and more than one extranodal site.

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: I will perform a lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and flow cytometry before treatment

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: I will not use high-dose intravenous methotrexate because his CrCl is about 47 mL/min.

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: I will not use high-dose intravenous methotrexate because his CrCl is about 47 mL/min.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: I will assess response with end-of-treatment FDG PET-CT using Lugano/Deauville criteria about 6-8 weeks after cycle 6, with a diagnostic CT component.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 indicates residual disease, with biopsy if feasible and management as refractory or partial disease.

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: Tumor lysis prophylaxis is high risk (bulky disease, LDH 1290, urate 10.4, eGFR 50): check G6PD and give rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg if normal, with aggressive IV hydration and every 6-12 hour monitoring of urate, potassium, phosphate, calcium, creatinine and LDH during cycle 1

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: check G6PD and give rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg if normal

sup_gcsf.quote: Give pegfilgrastim 6 mg after each cycle

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen immediately; use acetaminophen and short-acting opioids for pain, and avoid NSAIDs because of CKD, gout and bleeding risk.

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: Monitor glucose closely during prednisone and adjust metformin/insulin; metformin can continue at eGFR 50 but should be held during acute kidney injury or contrast exposure.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B antiviral prophylaxis is not needed because HBsAg and anti-HBc are negative with anti-HBs positive (immune).

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: Do not reduce dose preemptively for ECOG 2; his performance status is largely lymphoma-related and he is an anthracycline candidate.
